ops.text: Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law; and (d) where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement carries no insurance provision even though Commerce One places consultants on site, performs professional services and hosts data, so we have inserted our standard coverage package (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, statutory workers' compensation, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed) with certificates on request. If helpful, we can work to the fallback of E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.
proposal.summary: Insert a Commerce One insurance clause (CGL, E&O, workers' compensation, cyber) after Section 14.9

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.

Cyber and privacy insurance of USD 5M for vendors processing Customer Data.
Workers' compensation as required by law.
